Saturday 14 Nov

Cajun Salmon with Herby Cauliflower Rice and Creamy Cucumber Salad

Fish35 minLow carb

Ingredients

Salmon
  • Skin-on salmon fillet440 g
  • Cajun spice8 g (3½ tsp)
  • Salt¼ tsp
  • Olive oil½ tbsp
Cauli rice
  • Olive oil½ tbsp
  • Cumin seeds3 g (1½ tsp)
  • Cauliflower380 g
  • Fresh parsley19 g
  • Fresh mint13 g
  • Lemon1
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Sun-dried tomatoes40 g
Cucumber salad
  • Cucumber1
  • Fresh dill19 g
  • Natural yogurt210 g
  • Salt¼ tsp
  • Black pepper½ tsp

Method

  1. Prep. Thinly slice the cucumber. Roughly chop the sun-dried tomatoes, dill, parsley and mint. Zest the lemon.
  2. Make cauli rice. Grate or blitz the cauliflower until it looks like rice grains. Heat a little oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat, fry the cumin seeds 1 min, add the cauliflower with salt and pepper and fry 5–7 min until tender. Cover to keep warm.
  3. Cook salmon. Cut into portions, sprinkle all over with the cajun spice (spicy) and a pinch of salt. Fry skin-side down in a little oil over medium-high heat 3–4 min, flip and cook 3–4 min more until cooked through. Or bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 10–12 min.
  4. Finish cauli rice. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, parsley, half the mint and half the lemon zest. Cover to keep warm.
  5. Prepare salad. Mix the cucumber, dill, yogurt, remaining mint and lemon zest with a pinch of salt and pepper.
  6. Serve the cauli rice topped with the salmon and a spoonful of cucumber salad, with a squeeze of lemon.

Mint darkens with heat, so add it to the cauli rice just before serving.

Sunday 15 Nov

Classic Steak with Creamy Mushroom Sauce and Green Beans

Red meat30 min

Ingredients

Steak
  • Rump steak500 g
  • Vegetable oil1¼ tbsp
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Black pepper½ tsp
Sides
  • Mushrooms310 g
  • Fresh chives19 g
  • Garlic3 cloves
  • Olive oil1¼ tbsp
  • Water130 ml (about ½ cup)
  • Cream cheese100 g
  • Soy sauce13 ml (2½ tsp)
  • Black pepper½ tsp
  • Green beans190 g

Method

  1. Fry steak. Pat the steaks dry, rub with oil and season with salt. Fry in a very hot pan 2–4 min each side, or to your liking. Rest on a plate, then season well with pepper.
  2. Prep. Clean the mushrooms with a cloth (don't wash them) and chop or tear. Finely chop the chives. Mince the garlic.
  3. Start sauce. Return the pan to medium-high with a little oil. Fry the mushrooms 6–7 min, add the garlic for 1 min, then add the water, cream cheese, soy sauce and pepper. Simmer 3–4 min until thick.
  4. Boil beans. Trim the green beans and cook in salted boiling water 3–4 min. Drain.
  5. Serve the steak with the mushroom sauce and beans, garnished with chives.

A knob of butter and a pinch of sea salt on the green beans is a nice extra.

Monday 16 Nov

Soy Glazed Chicken with Asian Slaw and Sushi Rice

Chicken30 min

Ingredients

Chicken and glaze
  • Chicken breast500 g
  • Corn starch50 g (about 7 tbsp)
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Water65 ml (about ¼ cup)
  • Vegetable oil¾ tbsp
  • Soy sauce25 ml (1¾ tbsp)
  • Sweet soy sauce17 ml (1 tbsp)
Asian slaw
  • Rice vinegar18 ml (1¼ tbsp)
  • Mayonnaise65 g (4½ tbsp)
  • Tahini25 g (1¾ tbsp)
  • Chilli jam23 g (about 1 tbsp)
  • Large red chilli1
  • Carrot1½
  • Sugar snap peas170 g
Sushi rice
  • Sushi rice190 g
  • Water380 ml (about 1½ cups)
  • Salt½ tsp

Method

  1. Prep chicken. Wrap the chicken breasts in cling film and bash with a rolling pin until half as thick. Keep 1¼ tsp corn starch aside for the glaze; toss the chicken with the rest and a good pinch of salt.
  2. Boil rice. Rinse the sushi rice until the water runs clear. Put in a pot with the salt and water, bring to the boil, then cover and cook on low for 15 min until absorbed. Take off the heat and let it steam.
  3. Prep slaw. Mix the mayonnaise, rice vinegar, tahini and chilli jam with a pinch of salt. Finely chop the chilli (spicy), grate the carrot, slice the sugar snaps lengthwise; stir into the dressing.
  4. Fry chicken. Fry the coated chicken in a little oil over medium-high heat for 3–5 min each side until golden and cooked through. Set aside; wipe the pan.
  5. Make glaze. Mix the water, soy sauce and sweet soy sauce with the reserved corn starch. Heat in the pan for 1 min until thick, then toss the chicken in it.
  6. Serve the chicken with the slaw and rice, drizzling the remaining glaze over the chicken.

Let the sushi rice steam dry in the pot after cooking. Go easy on the chilli if sensitive to spice.

Wednesday 18 Nov

Seabream and Potato Mash with Green Beans and Garlic Butter

Fish30 minTips for kids

Ingredients

Seabream and butter
  • Seabream fillets410 g
  • Fresh parsley19 g
  • Garlic4 cloves
  • Butter65 g
  • Capers25 g (about 2¾ tbsp)
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Vegetable oil1¼ tbsp
Sides
  • Potatoes750 g
  • Grated Parmesan40 g
  • Whole milk130 ml (about ½ cup)
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Black pepper½ tsp
  • Green beans190 g

Method

  1. Make mash. Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil. Peel and chop the potatoes and boil over medium-high heat 20 min until soft. Drain, return to the pot with the Parmesan and mash, gradually adding milk to the consistency you like. Season.
  2. Prep. Finely chop the parsley. Mince the garlic. Trim the green beans. Bring a second pot of salted water to the boil.
  3. Make garlic butter. Melt the butter with the garlic over medium-low heat, add the parsley and capers and cook 1–2 min. Keep warm, without burning.
  4. Boil green beans over medium heat 5 min until tender. Drain.
  5. Fry seabream. Pat dry and salt the skin. Fry skin-side down in a little oil over medium-high heat 4 min until crisp, flip and cook 1 min more.
  6. Serve the fish on the mash with the beans, drizzled with garlic butter.

For kids: keep some chopped parsley and plain garlic butter (before the capers go in) aside, and serve the mash, beans and fish separately.

Thursday 19 Nov

Honeynut Squash Soup with Herby Croutons

SoupAbout 20 min1 mirepoix + 2 squash cubes

Ingredients

Soup
  • Mirepoix cube, from the freezer1
  • Squash cubes, from the freezer2
  • Chicken bone broth2 cups (about 480 ml)
  • Water1 cup (about 240 ml)
  • To serve: croutons, crema, or nothing

Method

  1. Put the cubes, broth and water in a pan over medium heat.
  2. Cover and let everything defrost and come to a simmer.
  3. Blend with a stick blender and check the seasoning.
  4. If too thick, add ¼ cup water or stock.
  5. Top with croutons or crema.

Friday 20 Nov

Barbecue Fajitas with Mushrooms, Peppers and Guacamole

Vegetarian20 min

Ingredients

Fajitas
  • Red onion1
  • Red pepper1
  • Yellow pepper1
  • Black beans300 g
  • Chestnut mushrooms310 g
  • Vegetable oil1¼ tbsp
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Smoked paprika3 g (1¼ tsp)
  • Fajita seasoning6 g (2½ tsp)
  • Barbecue sauce50 g (3 tbsp)
  • Chipotle powder3 g (1¼ tsp)
  • Avocado1
  • Lime1
  • 8" tortilla wraps8
  • Fresh coriander19 g

Method

  1. Prep. Slice the onion. Deseed and slice the peppers. Drain and rinse the beans. Clean the mushrooms with a cloth (don't wash them) and slice.
  2. Fry mushrooms in oil over medium-high heat with a pinch of salt for 5 min.
  3. Add the rest. Add the onion and peppers with a pinch of salt and fry 3 min. Add the smoked paprika, fajita seasoning, beans, BBQ sauce, a pinch of chipotle (spicy) and a splash of water. Season and cook 2 min more.
  4. Make guacamole. Mash the avocado with salt and the juice of half the lime. Cut the rest of the lime into wedges.
  5. Warm tortillas in the microwave or a warm oven.
  6. Serve. Fill the wraps with the veg, top with guacamole and coriander, with lime wedges on the side.
